user.title: Set up Gaffer
user.description: Gaffer checks that automations, scripts, scenes, and HomeKit Bridge commands have the expected result on your devices. It does not change automations or devices.

runtime_failure.title: {name} does not have the expected result
runtime_failure.description:
{name} ran and did not have the expected result {count} times in the last 24 hours.

Failed entities and verdicts: {failures}.

Gaffer does not change automations. Open the automation trace to find the cause. This issue clears when the next 3 runs have no failure, or after 24 hours with no failure.
